meta.description: Edit phylogenetic tree structure with Biopython Bio.Phylo, and treat rooting as a separate statistical inference rather than a display choice.
meta.executed: 8/9 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, ete3 3.1.3, ape/phangorn, MAD 2.2, FastRoot 1.5, IQ-TREE 2.4.0); Input 6 is a routing answer. RootDigger and Newick Utilities not executable.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Skill snippets used verbatim (file names only). SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: All results from runs on synthetic trees with known roots.

methodological_ground.detail: Root uncertainty reported with rootstrap and AU sets; basal claims refused; soft polytomies labelled.

code_usability.detail: Outgroup, collapse, prune snippets, the MAD strip regex, the IQ-TREE root-test command and all four examples run.

functional_suitability.note: Outgroup guard, dual-label collapse, 1e-6 tolerance, root-test command and MAD strip verified. The outgroup snippet tests only outgroup monophyly although its Approach says to check ingroup monophyly (Input 8).

reliability.note: Assert before collapsing; accurate Common Errors rows; no ingroup check in code.

agent_usability.note: Traps that bite on IQ-TREE trees are now covered.

maintainability.note: Examples use IQ-TREE-style layouts and dual labels; still toy trees.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing; RootDigger still named without flags.

recommendations.title: Check ingroup monophyly in the outgroup snippet
recommendations.problem: The code tests only outgroup monophyly, so an LBA sister pair used as outgroups passes and is rooted on.
recommendations.root_cause: The Approach's ingroup check was not coded.
recommendations.fix: After rooting, assert tree.is_monophyletic(ingroup) and print the warning otherwise.

recommendations.title: Give RootDigger flags or drop it
recommendations.problem: RootDigger is recommended without a command.
recommendations.fix: Add 'rootdigger --msa aln --tree tree --exhaustive' or route to the IQ-TREE command.
